info.title: Super Heavy God Gravion
info.synopsis: Siamo nel 2041 d.C. Un nuovo nemico chiamato Zeravire appare improvvisamente nel sistema solare, distruggendo tutte le installazioni militari che incontra. Tuttavia, un uomo facoltoso di nome Klein Sandman era già a conoscenza dell'imminente invasione e per questo stava preparando segretamente il suo esercito per la battaglia. La sua carta vincente è Gravion, un robot gigante che utilizza la gravità come fonte di energia. Nel frattempo il giovane Eiji entra di nascosto nella base di Sandman alla ricerca della sorella scomparsa. Finirà, insieme ad altri cinque ragazzi a salire a bordo del super-robot Gravion, per cercare di respingere la minaccia Zeravire.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: While searching for his missing sister, Eiji Shigure secretly enters the castle of millionaire Klein Sandman. There he meets the castles strange inhabitants and is selected to join in Sandmans mission to stop a destructive alien known as the Zeravire. The teams weapon, a series of fighting robots designed by Sandman called the Gran Kaiser and the Gran Divas who when needed join together to form Gravion.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The newly formed Gravion faces off in their first battle against the Zeravire and the pilots discover their weaknesses. Meanwhile The Earth Federation Alliance plan their own attacks on the Zeravire.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Eiji begins to get used to life in Sandman's castle and to the castles inhabitants. As he and Toga venture to the forbidden area of the castle in search of Eiji's sister Ayaka and the identity of the G-Shadow's pilot, Raven attempts to convince the EFA to allow Earthgertz to take the lead in the defense against the Zeravire.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: When a ghostly figure is sighted in one of the castle's towers, Toga and Eiji go to investigate. There they discover Leele, the mysterious pilot of the G-Shadow.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: In an effort to get to know each other better, the team goes on a picnic together but Leele is hesitant to share as she is haunted by nightmares of her past. Meanwhile the EFA attempts to find information of Sandman.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Eiji sneaks out of the castle during the staffs shopping day and takes Toga along with him for his first day out of the castle and his first day in the big city. As the maids search for them, the Zeravire launch an attack on the city.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: On the anniversary of her father Isanas death, Luna returns home to the island of Okiaowa but is surpirsed when she finds that the rest of of the Gran Knights have decided to accompany her to the have some fun on the island. But all fun is soon ended when the Zeravire target the International Peace Conference for their next attack.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: When the Zeravire attacks the the castle, all hope of stopping it lies with Eiji, who has accidentally found himself piloting the Gran Kaiser. To survive he must call upon all the power of the Gran Kaiser and all that his body can withstand.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Repairs begin on the castle following the attack by the Zeravire and Eiji begins to recover from his battle but runs from his physical and runs into Mizuki who gives him insight to the disappearance of his sister Ayaka. Together they decide to investigate where she vanished, the West Tower.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Following recent events, Sandman reluctantly has an auto-pilot device, The Gran Phantom intstalled into the Gran Kaiser in case of emergency. And one does arise when a Zeravire with a nuclear power supply attacks and one of the maids is put in danger, causing Eiji to try and rescue her while the rest of the Gran Knights use the system and go into battle with out him.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: After seeing what darkness Toga is capable of in the heat of battle, Eiji quits the Gran Knights and leaves the castle to return to a normal life. Leele ventures to town to convince Eiji to come back. Two pilots down, Gravion must operate with its auto-pilot taking up the slack when the Zeravire attack.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: The battle wages on as Gravion fights against the attacking Zeravire with a failing auto-pilot and Eiji and Leele still missing. But after his friend Yumi is injured in the attack, Eiji decides that his place is with the rest of the Gran Knights on Gravion.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The Zeravire have been evolving, not in order to destroy humans, but to ensure the destruction of Gravion. When the new and improved Zeravire comes to Earth to challenge Gravion, Sandman is hesitant to let the Gran Knights go to battle but they refuse to sit on the sidelines. With no other choice, Sandman must authorize the use of Gravions most adavanced weapon.

info.title: Mao
info.synopsis: Nanoka è una normale studentessa delle medie. Sopravvissuta a un inspiegabile incidente anni prima, la sua vita prende una svolta quando, attraversando una vecchia galleria nel suo quartiere, si ritrova catapultata nell’era Taishō: un Giappone oscuro e intriso di eventi soprannaturali.In questo mondo incontra Mao, un enigmatico esorcista maledetto, alla ricerca di un'entità demoniaca legata al suo passato. Nanoka si ritrova coinvolta nei suoi scontri contro il soprannaturale, e man mano che i misteri si infittiscono, il suo stesso passato torna a galla. Insieme affrontano yōkai, rituali occulti e misteri del passato, cercando risposte su ciò che li lega e su come fermare la minaccia che li coinvolge.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka is an attuned adolescent. So when a covered shopping arcade beckons, a strange world awaits.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka discovers that the arcade links to the Taisho era, while Mao probes a mysterious murder case.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka is unharmed by Mao's cursed sword. She returns to modern times to investigate an accident.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka and Otoya infiltrate the Shorinkyo cult, but get trapped inside by the leader, Shoko.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Earthquakes plague Taisho-era Fifth Street. Mao and Otoya find a church atop a sacred keystone site.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka reveals that she is from 100 years in the future. She goes back in time to question Mao.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: In the Taisho era, Nanoka is abducted by Byoki. Mao tries to help but collapses.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Mao is attacked by Hyakka, a fire-wielding onmyoji. He reveals a secret about the Goshikido.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Mao and the gang help the injured Tenko. Kuchinawa, who appears on the scene, turns out to be Kamon.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: A giant made of fish and water demands that Mao teach him the ultimate onmyoji spell, Taizanfukun.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Mao tries to help a sick boy but walks into a trap. A shikigami attacks Mao, trying to capture him.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Mao recalls the Goko Clan's water sorcerer. Kamon reunites with Shiranui at a water temple.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Nanoka carries Byoki's message for Mao to the Taisho era. Kamon exposes Shiranui's scam.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Rumors of a life-extending Goko Clan onmyoji lead Kamon and Mao to investigate Yurako.

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Shiranui demands the Taizanfukun spell from Mao, but Mao is enraged that Yurako is working for him.

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: Hakubi attacks Mao with Metal sorcery. Mao transforms into a beast and goes on a rampage.

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: After battling Hakubi, Mao falls into a deep sleep. Nanoka and Shiraha investigate cats and Onmyodo.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: Natsuno reveals Daigo and Sana's past. Mao and Kamon unlock the mystery of the Undersea Shrine.

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: Mao and his crew head for the Undersea Shrine. Kamon is driven into a corner by Shiranui's sorcery.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: Kamon seeks Masago's stolen body. Natsuno links Yurako's evil energy to Sana's death.

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: After battling Ichima Kagami, Mao takes the injured Soma to the clinic, but Soma slips away.

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: A cursed puppet needle transforms Mao into a beast and turns him against his friends.

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: Mao follows a patient who slips out of the hospital to eat grave dirt and uncovers a powerful curse.

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: Natsuno discovers a buried village, but seeks Kamon's help after being attacked by ayakashi.

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: Kagari Hosho attacks Nanoka, but Mao rescues her. Kagari tracks her down and takes her to Yurako.

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: Yurako reveals her past as a vessel for curses in the Heian period and her first meeting with Mao.

info.title: Deadman Wonderland (ITA)
info.synopsis: Per Ganta Igarashi, in fin dei conti, poteva trattarsi di un gita scolastica qualunque. Il parco di divertimento “Deadman Wonderland” è però un luogo insolito, nel quale i carcerati si esibiscono in ogni genere di pratica rischiosa, pur di accontentare i gusti ludici del pubblico. Prima di partire per la gita, i compagni di Ganta vengono brutalmente assassinati da un misterioso uomo in rosso. Il destino è doppiamente crudele per il ragazzo, accusato dalle autorità del massacro. Uscirne non è un gioco, e Ganta dovrà sopravvivere, vincendo dei giochi a dir poco sadici, resi pericolosi da un letale collare...

related.title: Deadman Wonderland: The Red Knife Wielder

variants.title: Deadman Wonderland: The Red Knife Wielder

episodes.title: Condannato a morte
episodes.synopsis: Ganta quickly learns of the very real dangers lurking around every corner in Deadman Wonderland. He soon meets the unusual Shiro, and while defending her from other inmates, discovers a strange new power within himself.

episodes.title: L'antidoto (La caramella)
episodes.synopsis: In order to earn “cast points” that he can use to buy antidote for the poison injected by his collar, Ganta goes head to head with one of the prison’s toughest inmates in a deadly obstacle course.

episodes.title: Il settore G
episodes.synopsis: Unable to afford antidote, Ganta faces his impending death - until You comes to his rescue. Later, after learning that the Red Man might be an inmate, Ganta, Shiro, and You venture into the secluded G Block to find the truth.

episodes.title: Crow - Claw
episodes.synopsis: Ganta is locked away in Tamaki’s lab after tangling with Senji, who wields powers similar to his own. While quarantined, Ganta learns more about his new abilities - and discovers that he’ll soon have to use them in a fight to the death.

episodes.title: Carnival corpse
episodes.synopsis: When Ganta faces Senji in his first Carnival Corpse, he learns that the effect of using his powers recklessly might be even deadlier than his opponent. Meanwhile, Yoh discovers there is more to Shiro than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Hummingbird
episodes.synopsis: Ganta meets Minatsuki, who’s locked up for killing her abusive father. When Ganta’s efforts to help her escape are thwarted, he’s forced to take on Minatsuki in a Carnival Corpse - and the girl shows her cruel true colors.

episodes.title: Il peccato originale
episodes.synopsis: Ganta meets Karako and Nagi, the leaders of the rebel faction Scar Chain, who help Minatsuki out of a potentially gruesome bind. Unfortunately, Ganta also meets Genkaku, a guitar-toting monk with a real talent for brutal violence.

episodes.title: La catena della libertà
episodes.synopsis: Ganta decides to join Scar Chain after hearing their plan to expose Deadman Wonderland’s darkest secrets. The plot isn’t without risks - and there’s a chance that the Undertakers are already working to sabotage the operation.

episodes.title: Catalizzatore ossidante
episodes.synopsis: Ganta and his Scar Chain comrades find themselves bloodied after an encounter with Genkaku’s crew. Things don’t get any better when the battle ends, thanks to a sudden appearance and shocking decision by Shiro.

episodes.title: I guardiani della tomba
episodes.synopsis: Ganta lashes out at Shiro for destroying the data chip and the Scar Chain’s resolve continues to be tested thanks to a traitorous confession by Rokuro. Things are looking grim for Ganta and his allies - until Senji enters the fight.

episodes.title: Il Gig della disperazione
episodes.synopsis: Ganta asks Senji to train him to better utilize his powers in battle. Later, after Karako is captured trying to save Nagi, Ganta unleashes his new skills during a rescue attempt - but it might already be too late, thanks to Genkaku.

episodes.title: Salvezza
episodes.synopsis: Ganta, battered in battle and weakened by the poison coursing through his body, tries to use the last of his strength to take out Genkaku - but Shiro might be his only hope.

info.title: One Piece: Heroines
info.synopsis: Le protagoniste femminili di One Piece sono al centro di una raccolta di brevi storie autonome. Nami partecipa a una sfilata di moda che avrà un impatto significativo sul suo percorso. Robin collabora con Koala e Sabo nell’analisi di un antico manufatto. La principessa Vivi riceve una lettera anonima da un ammiratore e riflette sulla situazione. Perona si trova coinvolta in una disputa con Zoro e Mihawk per l’ultima bottiglia di vino.

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis: After buying poorly made shoes, Nami returns to the shop and meets Lebno, the designer. He offers to create a new pair from scratch, on the condition that she becomes his model. However, the craftsperson Miucha is the one who does the work.

info.title: The Ramparts of Ice 2
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di The Ramparts of Ice

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Gray skies mirror the group's uneasy mood. Momoka senses a chance to get closer to Minato, while Miki can barely face Yota after turning him down.

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: Cultural festival prep begins and Miki and Yota ease back to normal. But as Minato grapples with his desire to stay close to Koyuki, Momoka makes a move.

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: Reeling from the news that Minato and Momoka are dating, Koyuki fights to keep her composure. Miki, meanwhile, confronts Minato about his true intentions.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: In agony over Minato, Koyuki confides in Tsukiko — who sees what Koyuki refuses to. Then a run-in with Igarashi forces her to reflect on her own walls.
